en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a garden scene in front of a building, likely part of a monastery complex. The focal point is a decorative stone fountain in the center of a well-maintained garden, featuring a sculpture of a crowned lion holding a staff. Surrounding the fountain are lush plants and flowers. In the background, part of a multi-story building with shuttered windows is visible. The card has a vintage appearance and contains a descriptive caption at the bottom.
